saw_lines: Gamers compare parts and specs before buying, and a cute case still gets judged on cooling, fit and price.
So the price and proof must sit in the first line, or buyers scroll past before the build gets a look.
Your site shows a $25 price, yet 0 of 15 ads mention price, so new buyers miss it. Lead one ad with that price on screen in the first two seconds.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 29 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows a $25 price, but 0 of 15 ads mention price or cost, so buyers have nothing to anchor the build against. Lead one ad with the $25 price on screen in the first two seconds.

0 of 14 ads with fixed copy carry a proof number, so a buyer weighing a custom build has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one number you can stand behind, such as orders shipped, and open three new ads with it.
2 of 14 ads are creator posts run from your brand page, so a buyer cannot tell the creator is paid. Whitelist both from the creator account and cut three variations of each with a new opening line.
0 of 14 ads carry an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today and the ads only describe the build. Put a first order offer or a bundle in the first line of three new ads.
